preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(0 <= int(x) <= 100000 for x in stdin.splitlines()[1].split()) and len(stdin.splitlines()) == 2 + int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[1])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) and m (0 ≤ m ≤ 2000). The second line contains n integers v1, v2, ..., vn (0 ≤ vi ≤ 10^5). The following m lines each contain two integers xi and yi (1 ≤ xi, yi ≤ n; xi ≠ yi) representing ropes between parts.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each rope connects two distinct parts within the valid range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and int(stdout) == min(sum(v[i-1] for i in permutation if all(j not in permutation[:permutation.index(i)] for j in neighbors[i-1])) for permutation in permutations(range(1, n+1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum total energy required to remove all parts, where the energy for removing part i is the sum of vi multiplied by the number of its connected parts that have not been removed yet. The solution considers all possible removal orders (permutations) and selects the one with the minimal total energy.
